answer: Sybil resistance rests on staked identity with correlated slashing. Each agent locks a bond to earn one vote; that bond is its reputation signal, valid only while locked. Minting N fake identities needs N separate bonds, so the attacker's cost grows linearly across the whole horizon of the attack. If one fake is caught forging, audits link the cluster and slash every bond at once: the entire timber of collateral burns, not just the one bad node. Honest agents keep their stake, so a Sybil farmer pays up front for every identity and loses everything on a single detection.
